Then check the checking account status for user_01, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, and prepare a high-priority app travel budget balance report using that checking balance in EUR terms. Also retrieve and publish the checking balance sheet in the app, and finally send a high-priority app alert with the checking balance amount.
